name: Dorfkrug Appartements
beschreibung:
Conveniently located in Telfs, Dorfkrug Appartements offer generous living space for couples, families, and business travellers. The modern apartments feature fully equipped kitchens, bright living rooms, and restful bedrooms.

Positioned between Innsbruck and the Seefeld plateau, the location opens up varied activities, from climbing the iconic Hohe Munde peak to visiting regional cultural sights.
kurzbeschreibung: Dorfkrug Appartements in Telfs provide spacious holiday residences and an ideal starting point for exploring the Tyrolean Inn Valley.
